$comment: Claude Desktop MCP configuration. Merge the `trading212` entry into your
existing claude_desktop_config.json, replacing the placeholder key.
Keep T212_ENVIRONMENT on `demo` until you have seen what the assistant
does with the data. Switching to `live` needs a separate API key.
T212_API_SECRET is only needed if your key was issued as a key/secret
pair. Omit it for an older single-token key.
